body.text: 1TPSS finally receive equipment from tacteam, added by Sir Htmine Bling, in what sources are calling "a formality that took considerably longer than a formality should"

In what insiders are already calling a genuinely momentous occasion, 1TPSS can confirm that equipment long promised has, at last, been delivered by tacteam and duly added to the game by Sir Htmine Bling. Fish News understands this development has been "in progress" for a period of time best described as geological.

body.alt: Members of 1TPSS alongside 4PS wearing their new equipment

body.text: A spokesperson for 1TPSS, speaking on condition of anonymity despite being the only person who could plausibly have said it, described the rollout as "surprisingly successful," a phrase Fish News notes is doing an enormous amount of quiet, uncomplaining work.

Asked whether the delay reflected any wider issues with the process — and keen to stress that tacteam themselves had done nothing whatsoever to cause it — one anonymous source, reportedly believed to be Sir Htmine Bling himself, which wouldn't be especially anonymous by any reasonable definition, replied only that "it's done now, isn't it," which Fish News regards as a masterclass in answering a question that was not, in fact, asked.

Members of 1TPSS were reportedly seen inspecting the newly added equipment with the cautious optimism of people who have been let down before. One operator, granted anonymity that fooled precisely no one, offered the assessment that it "looks like it's meant to be there," a review Fish News is choosing to treat as a triumph.

Fish News will, as ever, continue to monitor the situation with the same rigorous impartiality for which it is not remotely known, and will report back the moment there is anything further to needlessly dramatise.
